editorialAuthorisation: Matt O'Brien authorises supported factual informational Watch updates without repeat publication permission. This is editorial authorisation, not clinical approval.
reviewType: AI-assisted scoped primary-source factual review; not clinical approval
scope: Seven-day factual review wave covering 63 exact ClinicalTrials.gov API records plus MHRA safety and Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland access sources. Complete current records were retrieved and the claim-bearing lifecycle/access content was read. No identity, sponsor, phase, recruitment state, actual/estimated date, enrolment, results-posting, withdrawal, safety or access wording change was found.

registryReviewSummary.interpretation: Passed estimated start dates remain estimates and are not converted to actual starts. Completed status is not a result. The one record with posted results, NCT06854952, already had that status in the reviewed baseline; outcomes were not newly interpreted.

supportSources.assessment: MHRA warning remains current and unwithdrawn. Severe persistent abdominal pain advice, rare severe/fatal pancreatitis wording and Yellow Card reporting remain supported; this review does not add clinical advice.
SMC public summary remains current and continues to describe restricted NHSScotland use. It does not establish individual eligibility, local capacity, stock or UK-wide access.

The complete Welsh Government HTML record was directly retrieved after the earlier monitored 403. Its 7 July 2026 update, specialist-service pathway, limited exceptions and 31 March 2027 review date remain unchanged. The earlier denied monitor attempt remains a retrieval event, not an evidence change.

The Department of Health announcement remains a dated plan for a first Regional Obesity Management Service phase in autumn 2026, not proof that the service has opened or that medicines are currently supplied.

remainingObstacles.error: Configured sponsor pipeline check remains HTTP 403 in the 19:30:58Z live health snapshot with no successful automatic baseline.
remainingObstacles.disposition: Retain verification_pending and check_delayed. ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07721597, CTIS 2026-525978-19-00 and Zealand's H1 2026 report corroborate trial initiation but do not certify the pipeline page's latest internally inconsistent wording. Seek a stable directly reviewable sponsor HTML/text replacement; do not weaken the 2 MiB limit.
